name: プロジェクトの属性概要
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create one Lighthouse LH09-0011 プロジェクトの属性概要, a compact TWO-row project metadata summary.
Hierarchy: ORIGINAL image1 controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, opticalstroke, alignment, spacing, smallcontrol anatomy and originalmarks. Mock image2 is SECONDARY Japanese content/layout, not its roughicons/omittedmarks. Image3 is official white materials only, nobuscontent.
Follow original two-row structure approx760x76logicalpixels. Row1: mutedlabel「属性」; originalprogresscircle adaptedgreen with「進行中」; original orange urgency squarewhite! with「最優先」; whiteoutlinedinitialavatar「山」with「山田 花子」; original startdatecalendar/arrowglyph then「3月30日 → 4月15日」. Original inline summary hasone startdateglyph, do not add an endcalendar.
Row2 indentedtoalignafter属性: preserve original blueglobe/team artworkmark then「礼拝準備」; preserve original multicolorSlackmark then「準備チャンネル」; tiny actualthree-round-dotellipsis. Restoremarks missing frommock; don't replacewithdotseparator or greencircles. No mintavatar.
Green only for progress state, urgentorange supportedby! andlabel, originalteam/Slackartworkcolors preserved, utilityglyphs #526173. Row1values Meiryo Regular14/24, mutedlabel/row2metadata Regular12/16, zerotracking, notbold.
Purewhite #FFFFFF canvas andcomponent, alignedbaselines, originalcompactgroupgaps, no cardwrapper or filledbutton. No addedproperties, headings, controls, metrics or English. Japanese/numerals exact, no clipping. Tight standalonecomponent framing withminimalouterpadding. Staticrastercandidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画像全体・切抜き・モックを実見。二段の日本語/状態/優先度/担当/期日/チーム/チャンネルを確認。原画像の橙!と青/Slackマーク復元、白会員輪郭。開始カレンダーが崩れ、3月30日の直前に原画像に無い矢印を追加しているため要修正。限定修正予定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
